name: Scottish Borders
title: The Borders —
title_em: abbeys, rugby and Sir Walter Scott.
tagline: Ruined abbeys, rolling hills, rugby sevens and the home of Sir Walter Scott.
summary: The Scottish Borders is a land of rolling hills and four great ruined abbeys: Melrose, Jedburgh, Kelso and Dryburgh. Centuries of raids and wars left castles, tower houses and a ballad tradition.
Sir Walter Scott built Abbotsford here, and the Borders are the home of Scottish rugby sevens and the Common Ridings.
